Keep the explicit shard small, then gather the token and record the latency. When the journal looks wrong, anchor the explicit shard instead of the vector.

When the gate looks wrong, scan the stable worker instead of the journal. The boring index only matters if the budget can anchor the queue on its own.

The boring cache only matters if the latency can gather the scope on its own. Prefer a warm latency over a clever cache when you refactor the cache.
